name: Review Wall
author: norml

sections.description:
Review Wall is a WordPress plugin that helps businesses collect and manage Google Reviews more effectively. It creates a smart review collection system that redirects positive reviews directly to Google Reviews while keeping negative feedback on your website for internal handling.

The plugin allows you to create multiple custom review collection URLs, each with a unique identifier. When customers want to leave a review, they’re initially directed to your website where they can rate their experience. Based on the rating threshold you set, the plugin automatically:

  • Redirects satisfied customers to your Google Review page to share their positive experience publicly
  • Captures feedback from unsatisfied customers on your own website, preventing negative public reviews while still collecting valuable feedback

Key Features

Create multiple Google Review URLs with unique identifiers

Set custom rating thresholds to determine review redirection

Customize the review collection page with your logo and branding

Easy-to-use admin dashboard for URL management

Capture negative feedback internally to improve your services

Generate short, easy-to-share URL keys for each review destination

Usage

Setting Up Your First Review URL

  1. Navigate to the Review Wall settings page in your WordPress admin area
  2. Add your company logo (optional)
  3. Set your rating threshold (e.g., 4 stars)
  4. Click on “Add New URL”
  5. Enter a name for this review destination (e.g., “Main Location”)
  6. Enter or generate a unique URL key
  7. Enter your Google Review URL
  8. Click “Add URL”

Sharing Review Links

Once you’ve created a review URL, you can share it with customers in several ways:
– In email signatures
– On business cards
– In follow-up emails after purchases
– In QR codes displayed in your physical location

The URL format will be: yourdomain.com/review-wall/?id=your_unique_key

Managing Customer Feedback

  • Positive reviews (above your rating threshold) will be automatically directed to Google
  • Negative reviews (below your threshold) will be captured on your website
  • You can view all captured feedback in the WordPress admin area
  • Use the feedback to improve your business operations

Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions about the plugin, please contact us at go@norml.studio.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the review-wall folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Review Wall’ in your WordPress admin menu to configure settings
sections.faq:
Can I create multiple review destinations for different locations or services?

Yes, you can create as many unique review URLs as needed, each with its own name and Google Review destination.

Can I customize the appearance of the review page?

Yes, you can customize not only your company logo but also the entire text content of the review page.

What happens if a customer gives a rating below my threshold?

Their feedback is captured on your website rather than sending them to Google. This helps prevent negative public reviews while still collecting valuable feedback.

Can I change the rating threshold?

Yes, you can adjust the rating threshold at any time in the plugin settings.
